start: Settings; the gym is online and entry machines are ready on the server; no machine added yet

steps.action: In the 'Entry machines' card tap 'Open entry machines'
user_sees: Title 'Entry machines', under it 'Finger or face machines at your gym’s door'
'No entry machines yet' and how it works
Button 'Add a machine'
Button 'Back to Settings'
must_not: An endless Loading…

steps.action: Tap 'Add a machine'
user_sees: Sheet 'Add a machine'
'Your machine’s brand' with the brands; a brand not ready reads '<brand>: coming soon' and cannot be picked
'Step 1: find the serial number' to 'Step 4: give each member their number'
Boxes 'Serial number' and 'Machine name' with the hint 'Leave it empty to call it "<default name>".'
must_not: A coming-soon brand that can be picked

steps.action: Type the serial, tap 'Save machine'
user_sees: The button reads 'Saving…'
A short message: 'Saved. <name> shows Online within a minute of its first call.'
A card for the machine with its brand, serial, an Online or Offline pill and when it last called
must_not: Two cards from one press
The machine shown Online before it ever called

start: Entry machines screen with one machine already listed

steps.action: Tap 'Add a machine' under the list
user_sees: The same 'Add a machine' sheet
must_not: The first machine replaced by the second

steps.action: Save a second serial
user_sees: Two cards, each with its own pill and lines
must_not: The same serial accepted twice

start: Add a machine sheet; and gyms where the feature cannot work

steps.action: Tap 'Save machine' with the serial empty
user_sees: Under the serial: 'Type the serial number from Menu > System Info on the machine.'
must_not: A machine saved with no serial

steps.action: Type a serial with a space or a dash, save
user_sees: 'A serial number has only letters and numbers, like CJDE231560123. Check it on the machine.'
must_not: The odd letters dropped and saved without a word

steps.action: Type a serial already on the list, save
user_sees: 'This machine is already on your list.'
must_not: A second card for one machine

steps.action: Type a very long machine name, save
user_sees: Under the name: 'Keep the name short: <n> letters at most.'
must_not: The name cut without a word

steps.action: Open the screen in a gym where the server part is not there
user_sees: 'Entry machines are not ready for your gym yet'
'MettleUp cannot talk to entry machines yet. Nothing you do here is saved. Message MettleUp on WhatsApp if you want it for your gym.'
No add button
must_not: An add sheet that looks as if it saved

steps.action: Open the screen in a gym that is not online
user_sees: 'Put your gym online first (Settings → Sign-in & data).'
must_not: An add button that fails later

steps.action: Open the screen when the list cannot be read
user_sees: 'Could not load your machines', the reason, and 'Try again'
must_not: An empty list shown as if there were no machines

start: Entry machines screen with one machine

steps.action: Leave the screen open while the machine stops calling
user_sees: Within about 30 seconds the pill changes from Online to Offline by itself
must_not: A machine shown Online for minutes after it stopped

steps.action: Tap 'Remove' on the card
user_sees: Sheet 'Remove <name>?'
'MettleUp stops reading entries from this machine. Entries already in the register stay. Members and their fingers stay on the machine itself.'
Buttons 'Remove machine' and 'Keep it'
must_not: The machine removed before the second tap

steps.action: Tap 'Keep it', open the sheet again, tap 'Remove machine'
user_sees: 'Removing…', then a short message '<name> removed.'
The card is gone
must_not: Past entries removed from the attendance register
The card back after a refresh

start: Entry machines screen with a machine that refused entries today

steps.action: Read the card
user_sees: A red line with the entries refused today, a line about the last one refused, and a line about unknown numbers
must_not: A member of another gym named on the card
Finger or face pictures shown or stored by MettleUp

steps.action: Read the remove sheet
user_sees: 'Members and their fingers stay on the machine itself.'
must_not: A promise that fingers are wiped from the machine

start: Settings as front desk staff; the gym has one entry machine

steps.action: Tap 'Open entry machines'
user_sees: The machine card with its Online or Offline pill, last call and refused entries
'Only the gym owner can add or remove a machine.'
No 'Add a machine' and no 'Remove' button
must_not: An add or remove button for staff

start: Settings as staff; the gym has no machine yet

steps.action: Tap 'Open entry machines'
user_sees: 'No entry machines yet', how it works, and 'Only the gym owner can add or remove a machine.'
No button
must_not: A button that opens the add sheet and then fails

steps.action: Open the screen in a gym where the server part is not there
user_sees: 'Entry machines are not ready for your gym yet'
must_not: A blank screen

start: Entry machines screen open as staff while the owner removes the machine elsewhere

steps.action: Keep the screen open
user_sees: Within about 30 seconds the card goes and the empty words show
The pill follows the machine: Online, then Offline
must_not: A removed machine still listed as Online

steps.action: Look for any way to add or remove a machine
user_sees: Only the line 'Only the gym owner can add or remove a machine.'
must_not: A staff sign-in able to add or remove a machine by any path
